Salesforce scratch-org capture: 2026-11-24 UTC.
Source versions: 62.0 and 67.0. Anonymous execution used sf apex run with --api-version; each test class was deployed with the matching apiVersion metadata and executed using sf apex run test --synchronous.
The custom object and custom metadata type and record are included in this directory. cases.json supplies each anonymous body; the test route wraps the same body in an @IsTest static method. Anonymous debug output is captured in the observation column. Test-route passes establish successful execution only; debug values were not retrieved for those rows.
The object metadata deployed at API 67.0. Each case class deployment succeeded. The scratch org was deleted successfully after the run. The first Dev Hub attempted reported LIMIT_EXCEEDED before an org was created; a second hub supplied this disposable org.

Nested if, try, and for insert probes were captured separately at both source versions on 2026-11-24. Anonymous execution rejected all six at compile time. All six matching @IsTest classes deployed; the try cases passed after catching the DML exception, and the if and loop cases failed with the DML exception recorded in org.tsv.
